title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Genesis 29: Jacob meets Rachel at the well, serves Laban and marries Leah and Rachel.

questions.text: What was on the mouth of the well Jacob found in the field?
questions.explanation: The stone on the well's mouth was large, and out of that well they watered the flocks.

questions.text: Where did the shepherds at the well say they were from?
questions.explanation: Jacob asked, "My relatives, where are you from?" They said, "We are from Haran."

questions.text: What did Jacob do when he saw Rachel coming with Laban's sheep?
questions.explanation: Jacob went near, rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

answers.text: He rolled the stone away and watered the flock
He waited until all the flocks were gathered
He sent the shepherds to call her father Laban
He gave her a gold ring and two bracelets

questions.text: How long did Jacob stay with Laban before Laban asked about his wages?
questions.explanation: Jacob stayed with him for a month, and then Laban asked, "Tell me, what will your wages be?"
Leah was the elder daughter and her eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

questions.text: How did the seven years Jacob served for Rachel seem to him?
questions.explanation: Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him but a few days, because of the love he had for her.

questions.text: Which servant did Laban give to his daughter Leah?
questions.explanation: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

questions.text: What reason did Laban give for giving Leah to Jacob instead of Rachel?
questions.explanation: Laban said, "It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn."

answers.text: Rachel had refused to marry Jacob
Jacob had not paid enough silver
The younger is not given before the firstborn
Rachel was promised to another man

questions.text: What did Leah name her first son?
questions.explanation: Leah conceived and bore a son and named him Reuben, saying that Yahweh had looked at her affliction.

questions.text: What did Leah say when she named her son Judah?
questions.explanation: She said, "This time I will praise Yahweh." Therefore she named him Judah, and then she stopped bearing.

answers.text: "Yahweh has heard that I am hated."
"Now my husband will be joined to me."
